title: Deuxième partie : variations sur l'équation des lacets [suite à La "Longue Marche" à travers la théorie de Galois…, pages 293 à 650, dont table des matières] : notes et copies de notes manuscrites (s.d.).

deep.reconstruction:
This page is a summary diagram (62) with commentary. It belongs to the 'variations sur l'équation des lacets' manuscript, Grothendieck's study of the profinite Grothendieck–Teichmüller-type group defined by the 'loop' (lacet) equations. Diagram (62) collects the groups built so far around a pair of indices rho, sigma.

The objects are as follows; their roles are inferred from the neighbouring pages.
- gamma_{rho,sigma} is a base group. It carries three characters: chi_gamma into Zhat^* (cyclotomic-type), and two sign characters epsilon_{gamma,rho} = epsilon'_gamma and epsilon_{gamma,sigma} = epsilon_gamma into {±1}.
- N*_rho, N*_sigma, G_{rho,sigma} and Z_{rho,sigma} map to gamma_{rho,sigma} via delta_rho, delta_sigma, delta_G and delta_Z.
- Gamma_{rho,sigma} maps to N*_rho and N*_sigma via theta_rho and theta_sigma. Square I is cartesian, so Gamma = N*_rho ×_gamma N*_sigma.
- M_{rho,sigma} maps to Gamma and to G via theta_G. Its elements are compatible triples (as for tau'_M on the previous page), so M = N*_rho ×_gamma N*_sigma ×_gamma G = Gamma ×_gamma G.
- Z_{rho,sigma} is an extension of gamma by L_0. By pulling it back one gets S_0Gamma = Gamma ×_gamma Z and S_0M = M ×_gamma Z, which is (57)-(58) on the previous page. These are the cartesian squares involving theta_Z and labelled III# and V.
- The left column describes the kernels of the maps to gamma ('S? = Ker delta_?'): SN*_rho × SN*_sigma, the same with extra factors L_0 and/or 𝔖^+, and so on. Together with Gamma, S_0Gamma, M and S_0M they form a cube whose six faces are said to be cartesian.
- 𝔖^+ is embedded canonically ('inj'). 𝔖 = {1, tau''}·𝔖^+ embeds into M via i_{𝔖,M} and into G via i_{𝔖,G} (dashed). This is the profinite group of 'symmetries' generated by the tau-type elements; compare the Zhat^+ embedding (61) via tau'.

The commentary makes four points.
- (a) Every arrow is injective or surjective, except the three arrows leaving gamma.
- (b) The squares are cartesian (fibre products).
- (c) The arrows marked pr are canonical projections of products onto partial products.
- (d) The inclusions M→G, N*_rho→G and N*_sigma→G from (45) are omitted because they would break commutativity. So these are 'moral' inclusions that are not compatible with the other maps.

The purpose is bookkeeping: setting up the system of extensions and fibre products in which the loop equations are to be solved. The next page defines the characters chi_? and epsilon_? on all these groups and the kernel notations ?^+, ?', ?'', ?^0.
errors: Count inconsistency: 'Les dix carrés (six faces d'un cube, et cinq carrés marqués I, II, III#, IV, V)' gives 6+5 = 11, not 10. Grothendieck changed 'quatre' to 'cinq' but did not update 'dix'.
Remark (d) concedes that the diagram is not commutative once the 'moral inclusions' from (45) are added. The diagram is only commutative as a partial diagram; this is a caveat rather than an error.

ideas.what: Systematic encoding of a family of profinite group extensions as iterated fibre products over a base gamma_{rho,sigma}, with pullback of the L_0-extension Z along theta-maps and cartesian cubes
ideas.modern_name: fibre products / pullback of group extensions; cartesian cubes of profinite groups
ideas.where_published: Not in published texts; the 'Longue Marche' and loop-equation material remains largely unpublished

ideas.what: Characters chi (cyclotomic-type to Zhat^*) and two sign characters epsilon on a Galois/Teichmüller-type group, with an embedded symmetry subgroup 𝔖 = {1, tau''}·𝔖^+
ideas.modern_name: cyclotomic character and orientation characters on GT-type groups / extended mapping class groups
ideas.usually_credited_to: Drinfeld, Ihara (GT setting); Grothendieck (Esquisse) for the programme
ideas.where_published: Esquisse d'un programme discusses Teichmüller tower and Galois action generally; this specific setup unsure

deep.surprise_reason: A bookkeeping summary diagram of fibre products and extensions, with no new theorem or connection beyond the setup of the unpublished loop-equation framework.
transcription_corrections: The vertex at the top right is L_0, not L_sigma.

In (a), the reading should be 'Toutes les flèches sont soit injectives (↪), soit surjectives (↠), à l'exception des trois flèches issues de gamma_{rho,sigma}'. The superscript insertion is unclear: possibly 'partielles' or 'parfaites', and 'partout' is also possible.
In (b), 'quatre' is struck out and replaced by 'cinq' before 'carrés marqués'. The original sentence reads '...et cinq carrés marqués I, II, III#, IV, V) sont cartésiens'.
In (c), the insertion above 'flèches' appears to be 'cinq'.
